messages:
maria (product): Proposal: define explicit SLA language for "burst credits" + rollover. Customers ask for assurances; we need clear measurable terms before pilot.

sam (eng-runtime): Agreed. We should only promise 'best-effort low-latency for X seconds per day at Y qps' and state preemption precedence. Implementation: ledger + atomic debit + per-tenant priority tag.

priya (eng-sre): SLA must include failure budget and observability. Suggest: 99.9% availability for non-preempted requests; preempted requests excluded from uptime calc. Alerting: when rollovers consumed > 50% for 2h.

noah (data): I'll provide baseline numbers: typical small pool uses ~120k tokens/day; recommend three tiers: 100k, 300k, 1M. Also provide expected rollover burn probability from last 90d.

tess (sales): For contracts: two clauses: (A) Rollover allowed up to 20% unused credits; (B) No rollover. Pricing: small flat + per-token overage. I'll draft sample language for pilot customers.

maria (product): Launch checklist items I want: short pilot (2 weeks), telemetry (credit_used, rollover_amount, preempt_events, p95/p99), runbook for emergency-disable, and customer-facing FAQ. Owners?

sam (eng-runtime): I'll own the ledger prototype (2 sprints).

priya (eng-sre): I'll own SLOs and runbook. Add synthetic preemption test.

noah (data): delivering tier recommendations and sim by EOW.

ops-bot: RFC draft created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/burst-credit-sla (access: product, eng-runtime, eng-sre, data, sales).

maria (product): Thanks — i'll consolidate and post an initial checklist Monday.
